# Portable reference-membership preparation quality review

**Verdict: PASS — external preparation before worktree metadata writes.**

Reviewed the package on unchanged clean Source `5fbebd9df3a60b6c29e09f7236c1b916fe4c4418`. The artifact manifest SHA-256 is `82832cd9320457a62eefe71bccdd779bfdb549a533b1c457cb0c60212444f5de`. No blocking findings.

All **90 logical whole-file payloads** decode from **64 JSON wrappers** to byte-identical retained originals. Every original and physical wrapper length/hash matches, every alias deduplicates exact bytes, and no unmanifested or unreferenced payload exists. The physical wrappers total **3,325,747 bytes**. All fourteen complete Source snapshots share one byte-identical payload; the raw compiler/CLI/review logs, earlier FAIL reports, pre-fix source and unexecuted recipe histories remain intact.

The five scoped current reviews remain PASS. The document and manifest accurately retain 136 passing xtask tests, all 22 membership regressions, ten expected-result CLI cases, scoped strict repository Clippy and workspace formatting. Optional cargo-shear remains documented as unavailable. All complete original fixtures and previous tests are unchanged, and source evidence receives zero original behavioral or runtime membership credit.

The proposed 66 destination files consist of the manifest, 64 JSON wrappers under the existing evidence exclusion and the single top-level task Markdown file under the existing Markdown exclusion. The seven Source pathspecs are unchanged. Canonical95, reference-manifest and prior census/declaration contracts have no changes. I independently rehashed all 4,750 Source files and checked current full index/status against the retained snapshots. Actual Source equivalence must still be checked after the owner writes and commits the proposed metadata.

The 50,893,168-byte normally built executable remains external; the package carries its exact compiler binding, size and SHA-256 rather than binary contents. Prepared documentation keeps full-workspace CI, lead current app and protected integration gates pending. It does not claim archive reverification, completed reference census, original parity, Android Studio fidelity or full task/IDE completion.

Only these external review reports were written. No worktree metadata, Source/Git/index, Cargo/compiler/cache, SDK/JVM/app mutation occurred. The reviewer read hold is released.
